newsitem.title: USA: Actress Liz Taylor undergoes brain surgery.
newsitem.headline: Actress Liz Taylor undergoes brain surgery.

text.p: Neurosurgeons began operating on actress Elizabeth Taylor on Thursday to remove a benign brain tumour, a hospital spokesman said.
Ron Wise, of the Cedars-Sinai Medical Centre, said the surgery had begun and that "everything is going as planned."

The tumour, on the left side of Taylor's brain, was detected this month during a brain scan as part of a routine physical examination. Doctors expect Taylor, who will be 65 next week, to recover without complications.
Doctors said they would hold a news conference at the hospital in Beverly Hills after the surgery was over.
The operation, originally scheduled for Feb. 17, was postponed partly because Taylor had been suffering from the flu and also because of a scheduling conflict with her surgeons.
Taylor attended a gala 65th birthday party in Hollywood on Sunday to benefit AIDS research. Her actual birthday is Feb. 27.
